491: @Composable
492: fun PremiumOptionsList(
493:     options: List<Option>,
494:     selectedOptionId: String?,
495:     correctAnswerId: String,
496:     correctExplanation: String,
497:     distractorDissections: List<DistractorDissection>,
498:     onOptionSelected: (String) -> Unit,
499:     deepBlue: Color,
500:     successGreen: Color,
501:     errorRed: Color,
502:     cardColor: Color,
503:     trapBackground: Color
504: ) {
505:     val labels = listOf("A", "B", "C", "D")
506: 
507:     Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
508:         options.forEachIndexed { index, option ->
509:             val isSelected = selectedOptionId == option.id
510:             val isCorrect = option.id == correctAnswerId
511:             val isAnswerSubmitted = selectedOptionId != null
512:             val showTrapFeedback = isAnswerSubmitted && isSelected && !isCorrect
513: 
514:             val targetBorderColor = when {
515:                 isAnswerSubmitted && isSelected && isCorrect -> successGreen
516:                 isAnswerSubmitted && isSelected && !isCorrect -> errorRed
517:                 isAnswerSubmitted && isCorrect -> successGreen.copy(alpha = 0.5f)
518:                 else -> Color.Transparent
519:             }
520: 
521:             val targetBgColor = when {
522:                 isAnswerSubmitted && isSelected && isCorrect -> successGreen.copy(alpha = 0.05f)
523:                 isAnswerSubmitted && isSelected && !isCorrect -> errorRed.copy(alpha = 0.05f)
524:                 else -> cardColor
525:             }
526: 
527:             val animatedBorderColor by animateColorAsState(targetValue = targetBorderColor, label = "borderColor")
528:             val animatedBgColor by animateColorAsState(targetValue = targetBgColor, label = "bgColor")
529: 
530:             Column {
531:                 Surface(
532:                     color = animatedBgColor,
533:                     shape = RoundedCornerShape(12.dp),
534:                     border = if (isAnswerSubmitted && (isSelected || isCorrect)) BorderStroke(2.dp, animatedBorderColor) else null,
535:                     shadowElevation = if (isAnswerSubmitted) 0.dp else 2.dp,
536:                     modifier = Modifier
537:                         .fillMaxWidth()
538:                         .clickable(enabled = !isAnswerSubmitted) { onOptionSelected(option.id) }
539:                 ) {
540:                     Row(
541:                         modifier = Modifier.padding(16.dp),
542:                         verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically
543:                     ) {
544:                         Box(
545:                             modifier = Modifier
546:                                 .size(36.dp)
547:                                 .background(deepBlue.copy(alpha = 0.05f), CircleShape)
548:                                 .border(1.dp, deepBlue.copy(alpha = 0.1f), CircleShape),
549:                             contentAlignment = Alignment.Center
550:                         ) {
551:                             Text(
552:                                 text = labels.getOrElse(index) { "" },
553:                                 color = deepBlue,
554:                                 fontWeight = FontWeight.Bold,
555:                                 fontSize = 14.sp
556:                             )
557:                         }
558:                         Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(16.dp))
559:                         Text(
560:                             text = option.text,
561:                             modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
562:                             color = deepBlue.copy(alpha = 0.9f),
563:                             fontSize = 16.sp,
564:                             lineHeight = 22.sp
565:                         )
566:                         if (isAnswerSubmitted) {
567:                             Spacer(modifier = Modifier.width(8.dp))
568:                             if (isSelected && isCorrect) {
569:                                 Icon(Icons.Filled.CheckCircleOutline, tint = successGreen, contentDescription = "Correct")
570:                             } else if (isSelected && !isCorrect) {
571:                                 Icon(Icons.Filled.HighlightOff, tint = errorRed, contentDescription = "Incorrect")
572:                             } else if (isCorrect) {
573:                                 Icon(Icons.Filled.CheckCircleOutline, tint = successGreen.copy(alpha = 0.5f), contentDescription = "Correct answer")
574:                             }
575:                         }
576:                     }
577:                 }
578: 
579:                 // Trap Dissection — only for the incorrectly selected option
580:                 AnimatedVisibility(visible = showTrapFeedback) {
581:                     val dissection = distractorDissections.find { it.optionId == option.id }
582:                     Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height(12.dp))
583:                     FeedbackBox(
584:                         title = "TRAP: ${dissection?.trapType?.uppercase() ?: "INCORRECT"}",
585:                         message = dissection?.dissection ?: "That is not the correct answer.",
586:                         color = errorRed,
587:                         bgColor = trapBackground
588:                     )
589:                 }
590:             }
591:         }
592:     }
593: }
